about_the_game:
VanillaBeast: Mystery Kink

Zoinks! There's foul play in Venereousville and only Vanilla and the gang can get to the bottom of this kooky mystery! Control Vanilla, Blake Blossom, Jewel De'Nyle, Kiki D'Aire, and Nickey Huntsman as they traverse over 10 hand-drawn levels in this funny and spooky comedy-horror adventure anyone (mature enough) can play!

short_description: Vanilla, Blake Blossom, Jewel De'Nyle, Kiki D'Aire, and Nickey Huntsman take on a sexy and hilarious story in this "throwback" comedy-horror adventure game spanning across several iconic horror parody levels including Camp Crystal Fake! Can you solve the mystery of the Legendary Phallus Stones?
